# Full Fantasy Statistics (Everything)
```{r}
stats <- load_player_stats(2026)

View(stats)
```

### Stats We Care About
```{r}
fantasy_players <- stats%>%
  filter(position %in% c("QB", "RB", "WR", "TE"))

fantasy_players <- fantasy_players %>%
  mutate(fantasy_points_half_ppr =
           fantasy_points_ppr - (receptions * 0.5))

fantasy_rankings <- fantasy_players %>% filter(week == max(week)) %>%
  select(
    player_display_name,
    position,
    team,
    week,
    fantasy_points_half_ppr
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(fantasy_points_half_ppr)) %>% relocate(fantasy_points_half_ppr, .after = player_display_name)

View(fantasy_rankings)

```

###Fantasy Averages
```{r} 
fantasy_averages <- fantasy_players %>% 
  group_by(player_display_name, position, team) %>% 
  summarize(
    average_points = mean(fantasy_points_half_ppr, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(average_points))

View(fantasy_averages)
```

### Recent Fantasy Avgs
```{r}
fantasy_recent_avg <- fantasy_players %>% 
  group_by(player_display_name, position, team) %>%
  arrange(week, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    recent_avg = rollmean(
      fantasy_points_half_ppr, k = 3, fill = NA, align = "right"
    )
  ) %>% 
  summarize(
    season_avg = mean(fantasy_points_half_ppr, na.rm = TRUE), 
    recent_avg = last(recent_avg),
    avg_targets = mean(targets, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_carries = mean(carries, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(season_avg), desc(recent_avg), desc(avg_targets))
          
View(fantasy_recent_avg)
```

```{r}
fantasy_model_data <- fantasy_players %>%
  group_by(player_display_name) %>%
  summarise(
    position = first(position),
    team = last(team),

    avg_fantasy_points = mean(
      fantasy_points_half_ppr,
      na.rm = TRUE),

    recent_avg = mean(
      tail(fantasy_points_half_ppr, 3),
      na.rm = TRUE),

    avg_targets = mean(
      targets,
      na.rm = TRUE),

    avg_carries = mean(
      carries,
      na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
View(fantasy_model_data)
```

### Matchup Difficulty

```{r}
schedule <- load_schedules(2026)
#View(schedule)
home_schedule <- schedule %>% 
  select(week,home_team, away_team) %>% 
  rename(
    team = home_team,
    opponent = away_team
  )
away_schedule <- schedule %>% 
  select(week, home_team, away_team) %>% 
  rename(
    team = away_team,
    opponent = home_team
  )
team_schedule <- bind_rows(
  home_schedule,
  away_schedule
) %>% 
  arrange(week, team)

#View(team_schedule)

fantasy_with_opponent <- fantasy_players %>% 
  left_join(
    team_schedule,
    by = c("team", "week")
  ) %>% 
  select(player_display_name, position, team, week, opponent, fantasy_points_half_ppr)

View(fantasy_with_opponent)
```

```{r}
defense_weekly <- fantasy_with_opponent %>% 
  group_by(opponent, position, week) %>% 
  summarize( 
    points_allowed = sum(fantasy_points_half_ppr, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup()

View(defense_weekly)

defense_matchup <- defense_weekly %>% 
  group_by(opponent, position) %>% 
  summarize(avg_points_allowed = mean(points_allowed, na.rm = TRUE),
           .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(desc(avg_points_allowed))

defense_matchup <- defense_matchup %>% 
  group_by(position) %>% 
  mutate(matchup_zscore = (avg_points_allowed - mean(avg_points_allowed, na.rm = TRUE))/sd(avg_points_allowed, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup()

View(defense_matchup)

next_week <- max(fantasy_players$week, na.rm = TRUE) + 1
upcoming_schedule <- team_schedule %>% 
  filter(week == next_week)

fantasy_model_data <- fantasy_model_data %>% 
  left_join(upcoming_schedule, by = "team")

fantasy_model_data <- fantasy_model_data %>% 
  left_join(defense_matchup, by = c("opponent", "position"))

View(fantasy_model_data)
```

### Chart to see The Teams Defense in Ranked Order
```{r}
ggplot(defense_matchup %>% filter(position == "RB"), mapping = aes(y = avg_points_allowed, x = reorder(opponent, -avg_points_allowed), fill = position)) + 
  geom_col() + coord_flip() + 
  labs(
    x = "Defensive Team",
    y = "Average Points Allowed to this Position"
  )
```

# Our First Predictor Model!!!!
```{r}
# Experimental weights selected using 2021-2024, evaluated on 2025.
# QB improved MAE by 0.128; RB worsened by 0.050; TE improved by 0.003;
# WR uses the season-average baseline. These are not universally optimal.
# Source this file after building fantasy_model_data, instead of the final
# prediction chunk. The earlier defense_matchup join must already exist.
position_weights <- tibble::tribble(
  ~position, ~season_weight, ~recent_weight, ~matchup_weight,
  "QB",      0.75,           0.25,           0.05,
  "RB",      0.75,           0.25,           0.10,
  "WR",      1.00,           0.00,           0.00,
  "TE",      1.00,           0.00,           0.05
)

apply_position_weights <- function(data, weights=position_weights) {
  required <- c('position','avg_fantasy_points','recent_avg','matchup_zscore')
  stopifnot(all(required %in% names(data)), !anyDuplicated(weights$position),
    all(data$position %in% weights$position))
  data %>%
    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c('season_weight','recent_weight','matchup_weight'))) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(weights, by='position') %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      baseline_prediction = season_weight * avg_fantasy_points +
        dplyr::if_else(recent_weight == 0, 0, recent_weight * recent_avg),
      predicted_points = baseline_prediction *
        (1 + dplyr::if_else(matchup_weight == 0, 0, matchup_weight * matchup_zscore))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-baseline_prediction) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(predicted_points, .before=position)
}

if (exists('fantasy_model_data')) {
  fantasy_model_data <- apply_position_weights(fantasy_model_data)
}
View(fantasy_model_data)
```

### Finding the right weights

```{r}
# 1. Prepare historical results
history <- fantasy_with_opponent %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(fantasy_points_half_ppr),
    !is.na(opponent)
  ) %>%
  arrange(week)

# Start predicting after at least three weeks
prediction_weeks <- sort(unique(history$week))
prediction_weeks <- prediction_weeks[prediction_weeks >= 4]

# 2. Build predictions using only information available before each week
backtest <- purrr::map_dfr(prediction_weeks, function(w) {

  past <- history %>% filter(week < w)
  actual <- history %>% filter(week == w)

  player_averages <- past %>%
    arrange(week) %>%
    group_by(player_display_name, position) %>%
    summarise(
      games_played = n(),
      season_avg = mean(fantasy_points_half_ppr),
      recent_avg = mean(tail(fantasy_points_half_ppr, 3)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(games_played >= 3)

  defense_scores <- past %>%
    group_by(opponent, position, week) %>%
    summarise(
      points_allowed = sum(fantasy_points_half_ppr),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(opponent, position) %>%
    summarise(
      avg_allowed = mean(points_allowed),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(position) %>%
    mutate(
      matchup_zscore =
        (avg_allowed - mean(avg_allowed)) / sd(avg_allowed)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  actual %>%
    inner_join(
      player_averages,
      by = c("player_display_name", "position")
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      defense_scores,
      by = c("opponent", "position")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Use a neutral matchup when a score isn't available
      matchup_zscore = if_else(
        is.finite(matchup_zscore), matchup_zscore, 0
      )
    )
})

# 3. Reserve later weeks for a final, independent check
weeks <- sort(unique(backtest$week))

if (length(weeks) < 3) {
  stop("Need at least three backtest weeks. Use more historical data.")
}

split_at <- floor(length(weeks) * 0.7)

tuning_data <- backtest %>%
  filter(week %in% weeks[seq_len(split_at)])

test_data <- backtest %>%
  filter(week %in% weeks[(split_at + 1):length(weeks)])

# 4. Try different weights
# Recent-average weight is always 1 minus season-average weight
weight_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  season_weight = c(0, 0.25, 0.4, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
  matchup_weight = c(0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15)
)

weight_results <- weight_grid %>%
  mutate(
    MAE = purrr::map2_dbl(
      season_weight,
      matchup_weight,
      function(sw, mw) {
        prediction <- (
          sw * tuning_data$season_avg +
          (1 - sw) * tuning_data$recent_avg
        ) * (1 + mw * tuning_data$matchup_zscore)

        mean(abs(
          prediction - tuning_data$fantasy_points_half_ppr
        ))
      }
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(MAE)

View(weight_results)

# 5. Evaluate the best weights on the untouched later weeks
best <- weight_results %>% slice(1)

test_results <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    model_prediction = (
      best$season_weight * season_avg +
      (1 - best$season_weight) * recent_avg
    ) * (1 + best$matchup_weight * matchup_zscore)
  )

comparison <- test_results %>%
  summarise(
    player_weeks_tested = n(),
    baseline_MAE = mean(
      abs(season_avg - fantasy_points_half_ppr)
    ),
    model_MAE = mean(
      abs(model_prediction - fantasy_points_half_ppr)
    )
  )

print(best) 
print(comparison)
```
